 More than 76 million people will see an increase in their benefits starting at the beginning of next year.
 By   Magalí Schefer 
 Translated and edited by   El Cronista EN Published on October 21, 2026 11:35 AM Add as a preferred source on Google abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña En esta noticia How much retirees will receive starting in 2027 
 When payments will begin 
 As happens every October, the United States Social Security Administration (SSA) revealed the expected final figure for the increase in retirement, disability, and other Social Security payments for 2027: 3.6% .
 Requirements . Social Security: what documents does the SSA require to apply for a card according to your immigration status abre en nueva pestaña From December 2026 to January 2027, 76 million people will receive an increase of $36 more per month , depending on the program and its conditions. With this new cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) , the federal government expects to offset the impact of inflation on each beneficiary’s income .
 How much retirees will receive starting in 2027
 The SSA made an average, and Social Security retirement benefits will increase by US$75 per month starting in 2027. The measure will benefit nearly 72 million Social Security beneficiaries. By category, the estimates showed:
 The increase comes in a context of new pressures on the cost of living in the country. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) , year-over-year inflation reached 3.7% in September 2026.
 When payments will begin
 The SSA will begin payments in December 2026 and January 2027:
 The 7.3 million beneficiaries of Supplemental Security Income (SSI) will receive their increased payment on December 31, 2026 , since January 1, 2027 is a holiday. 
 Social Security beneficiaries will receive their new payments in January 2027. The schedule has not yet been confirmed, but it is expected to follow the pattern used this year, which includes the 1st, the 3rd, and Wednesdays. 
 Some beneficiaries who are enrolled in both programs will receive both payments.
 COLA notices will be available toward the end of November 2026 in the Message Center of each beneficiary’s personal my Social Security account. Those who are not registered in the system will receive their notification by mail, but a month later .
